figures.caption: Effect of increasing concentrations of (A) SCH-P9, (B) SCH-P10 and (C) 5-FU on the growth of DU-145 and PC-3 cells for 6, 12 and 24 h. SCH, Sinonovacula constricta hydrolysates; 5-FU, fluorouracil.
